title: music-video shot plan
description: Structural schema for editors. plan_check.py enforces the rest (tiling, gaps, overlaps, audio length, files on disk).

audio.description: Path to the finished song, relative to the plan file.

audio_duration_seconds.description: Fallback when the audio file is not on disk.

style.description: One line prepended to every shot prompt.

stems.description: Stem name -> audio file (relative to the plan), same length and timing as the song, e.g. {"vocals": "stems/vocals.wav", "instrumental": "stems/instrumental.wav"}.

identities.description: Character name -> look string. Names in shot descriptions are replaced by the look; video models do not know your names.

frame.description: Keyframe filename in the frames directory (extension optional).

face.description: Used by model routing. Leave out when unsure.

framing.description: Used by model routing: sung close and medium shots go to the cheap lip-sync model, sung wides to Hailuo 3.

kind.description: Used by model routing: 'acting' = silent emotional acting, 'action' = physical action or a state change.

audio_ref.description: Audio reference with --audio-refs: 'mix' (default, the song), a key of 'stems' (sliced at the shot start), or a file path used from its start (e.g. a TTS line).
